sermon.title: Signs and the Message — June 27, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer closes the signs in John with three groups: those who believe and follow, those who believe but won’t come and follow, and those who won’t believe. He says belief is not enough, that following Christ means walking the road of justice, describes what happens when the wicked rule, and teaches that men are condemned because they love darkness, while those who do the truth come to the light.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The recording begins in prayer; the opening reading of John 20:30–31 is partly cut.

faqs.answer: He would rather have harmony in his marriage than eternal life with Jesus.

faqs.answer: No; justice only punishes those hurting other people.

faqs.answer: The body inside the woman has the same right as the mother and has no voice, so someone must stand up for it.

faqs.answer: They want to take away guns and put anybody on welfare who doesn’t want to work: “flat out socialism.”

faqs.question: Where is the emphasis in John 3:16?
faqs.answer: On God giving His Son, not on you believing.

faqs.answer: No; many taught well can quote scripture but are not living for Christ.
